name: Hidden Remote-Access Software
description: Software on Preston's laptop capable of wiping remote drives, installed weeks before Elena's death and hidden from the team.

name: Corporate Memo
description: An internal memo instructing Preston to 'ensure the Kestrel dataset does not reach publication' before quarterly results are finalized.

name: Server Room Access Log
description: A badge-swipe log placing Preston in the server room at the exact time of Elena's death, despite his claimed alibi.

name: Torn Insulated Glove
description: A torn cold-weather glove fiber caught in the server rack door, matching Preston's issued gear, not Elena's or Ravi's.

name: Ibrahim's Raw Data Backup
description: Naomi's independently stored raw data, offered freely and untouched by the wipe.
